claims: The 2026 Masters concludes on Sunday, April 12, with the final round.
The final pairing of Rory McIlroy and Cameron Young tees off at 2:25 p.m. ET.
Scottie Scheffler and Haotong Li tee off at 1:52 p.m. ET.
Jason Day and Justin Rose tee off at 2:03 p.m. ET.
Sam Burns and Shane Lowry tee off at 2:14 p.m. ET.
Paramount+ covers holes 4, 5, and 6 from 10 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. ET.
Paramount+ covers Amen Corner from 11:45 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET.
Paramount+ provides early coverage from 12 p.m. to 2 p.m. ET.
CBS and Paramount+ provide final round coverage from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET.
